# Wikipedia

> > Wikipedia is a free, multilingual online encyclopedia created through collaborative editing by volunteers worldwide, operated by the Wikimedia Foundation.

Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, Wikipedia has become the world's largest reference website with millions of articles across hundreds of languages. The English Wikipedia is the largest edition, featuring comprehensive coverage of topics ranging from history and culture to science and current events.

## About Wikipedia

- [Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Wikipedia homepage featuring articles, portal access, and site navigation
- [Wikipedia:About - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): About page explaining Wikipedia's mission and collaborative editing model
- [Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Main article about Wikipedia founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger
- [Wikipedia:Contents - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents): Site directory and navigation guide for browsing Wikipedia topics
- [English Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia): Article about the English-language edition of Wikipedia
- [History of Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia): Historical overview of Wikipedia's development from Nupedia origins

## Reference & Topics

- [Lists of capital cities - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lists_of_capitals): Index of national and subnational capital cities worldwide
- [British - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British): Disambiguation for British identity, culture, and UK-related terms
- [// - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki///): Disambiguation page for double-slash usage in programming and URIs
